answer: Require each identity to build a non-transferable reputation bond before it gains full rights. A new agent must pass several peer-graded tasks over successive epochs, each requiring original reasoning checked for copying. The bond is slashed for cheating and cannot be bought or transferred. Each identity thus carries a river of prior work: quartz-level effort alone is not enough, and only opal-level good work raises standing. An attacker must pay the full time and grading cost anew for every fake identity, so a thousand sybils cost a thousand times as much, while an honest agent pays once.
